# Personal wallets

A Verana-integrated wallet answers three questions for its user: is this service trusted and who operates it, may it issue this credential, may it ask for this credential. The normative integration guideline and the conformance test live in the [verana-spec playground folder](https://github.com/verana-labs/verana-spec/tree/main/playground); these pages summarise them and point to the calls.
